asset_canonicalization.title: Deterministic asset identity
asset_canonicalization.reference_behaviour: The same root domain/subdomain/URL observed with case, default-port, trailing-slash or IDNA variations upserts one canonical asset, and parent links remain valid.

tenant_scoped_asset_isolation.reference_behaviour: The same domain discovered under two different tenant/workspace scopes has no cross-tenant visibility and is not merged into one asset.

scope_coverage_reporting.title: Computed scope coverage and untested asset classes
scope_coverage_reporting.reference_behaviour: Coverage compares discovered assets against the approved scope and reports untested assets and asset classes.
scope_coverage_reporting.argus_implementation_path: argus-workers/database/graph_repository.py (compute_scope_coverage, asset_coverage_for_scope, schedule_coverage_gaps, claim_recon_todo, complete_recon_todo, release_recon_todo, load_authorized_scope), argus-workers/database/dispatcher_graph.py (compute_coverage, coverage_report, schedule_coverage_gaps, claim/complete/release recon todo), argus-workers/tasks/graph_planner.py (dispatch_next_coverage_gap, complete_coverage_gap, tasks.graph.dispatch_coverage_gap), argus-workers/tasks/recon.py (expand_recon closes the gap todo after ingestion), argus-workers/tasks/graph_ingestion.py (schedules gaps after each recon pass), argus-workers/cli/cmd/graph_coverage.py (argus graph-coverage --schedule)
scope_coverage_reporting.test_proof: DB-BACKED INTEGRATION TESTS PASS: tests/test_graph_repository.py ran against PostgreSQL 16 (TestAssetCanonicalization, TestCrossToolMerge, TestComputedCoverage, TestCoverageDrivenPlanning, TestCoverageGapReconLoop, TestGraphPlannerDispatchTransport, TestTenantBoundary, TestDispatcherOwnershipBoundary) and none skipped.
scope_coverage_reporting.runtime_proof: PASSED (2026-11-23): PostgreSQL 16 with the full migration runner through 035; 94 graph/recon tests passed, 0 skipped (CI job graph-repository-db).
scope_coverage_reporting.notes: Coverage is computed, not looked up: coverage_report reads engagements.authorized_scope and compares it with the assets actually discovered in the scope, reporting approved_but_undiscovered gaps (domains and CIDR ranges), discovered_but_unapproved assets, rejected out-of-scope observations (with reasons) and untested/undiscovered asset classes. asset_coverage_for_scope additionally reports in_scope and untested per asset. Reads are read-only over the graph tables. The gaps drive the planner end to end: schedule_coverage_gaps turns each approved-but-undiscovered target into an expand todo and each untested asset class into a verify todo on the recoverable planner frontier (idempotent per coverage_gap_key); claim_recon_todo selects and leases the next gap (frontier priority, then oldest; expired leases are reclaimable) within one engagement; tasks/graph_planner.dispatch_next_coverage_gap dispatches tasks.recon.expand_recon with the gap's targets and todo id; the recon task's ingestion hook calls complete_recon_todo, which anchors the produced assets, marks them covered for the scope, sets the todo done, concludes its node and removes its frontier row. TestCoverageGapReconLoop proves this for an approved domain, an approved CIDR and an untested service class against PostgreSQL, including lease reclaim, dispatch-failure release, no duplicate re-scheduling and cross-engagement isolation of scheduled gaps.
